privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your privacy is important to us. Learn how we protect and handle your personal information.
privacy.intro_text_1: Welcome to the official website of {fullBandName} ({bandName}). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your personal information when you visit our website and interact with our services.
privacy.intro_text_2: We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable data protection laws.
privacy.intro_text_3: By using our website, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.
privacy.collect_personal_desc: When you contact us through our website, we may collect the following information:
privacy.collect_personal_1: Name and contact details you provide in contact forms
privacy.collect_personal_3: Any other information you voluntarily provide
privacy.collect_personal_4: Records of your consent to data processing
privacy.collect_technical_desc: We may collect basic technical information:
privacy.collect_technical_1: Website usage data and analytics (if implemented in the future)
privacy.use_intro: We use the collected information for the following purposes:
privacy.use_communication_desc: To respond to your inquiries, questions, and requests sent through our contact forms.
privacy.use_security_desc: To protect our website, services, and users from fraud, abuse, and security threats.
privacy.share_intro: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information only in the following limited circumstances:
privacy.share_providers_desc: We may share information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our website and providing our services (e.g., hosting providers).
privacy.share_legal_desc: We may disclose your information if required by law, court order, or government regulation.
privacy.rights_intro: Under GDPR and applicable data protection laws, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.rights_access_desc: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
privacy.rights_rectification_desc: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data.
privacy.rights_erasure_desc: Request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten").
privacy.rights_objection_desc: Object to the processing of your personal data in certain circumstances.
privacy.rights_exercise_desc: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us directly at {email}. We will respond to your request within {dataResponseTime}.
privacy.cookies_text_1: Currently, our website does not use cookies. If we implement cookies in the future, we will update this Privacy Policy and our {cookiesPolicy} accordingly.
privacy.cookies_text_2: You can control cookies through your browser settings.
privacy.security_intro: We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction:
privacy.retention_text: We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.
privacy.children_text: Our services are not directed to individuals under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us.
privacy.changes_text_1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technologies, legal requirements, or other factors. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
privacy.changes_text_2: We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about how we protect your information.
privacy.contact_text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using our website, music, and services.
terms.intro_text_1: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the {fullBandName} ({bandName}) website, music, services, and any related content. By accessing or using our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms.
terms.intro_text_2: If you disagree with any part of these terms, then you may not access the service. These Terms apply to all visitors, users, and others who access or use the service.
terms.permitted_1: Personal, non-commercial enjoyment of our music and content
terms.permitted_2: Sharing our official releases through authorized platforms
terms.permitted_3: Engaging with our social media and fan community
terms.permitted_4: Using our website for information about releases and band updates
terms.prohibited_1: Unauthorized reproduction, distribution, or modification of our music
terms.prohibited_2: Commercial use of our content without explicit written permission
terms.prohibited_3: Attempting to reverse engineer, hack, or exploit our website
terms.prohibited_4: Using our services for illegal or harmful activities
terms.prohibited_6: Uploading malicious code, viruses, or harmful content
terms.ip_music_desc: All music, recordings, and compositions are owned by {bandName} and protected by copyright law.
terms.ip_visual_desc: Photos, videos, artwork, and graphics are our exclusive property and may not be used without permission.
terms.ip_brand_desc: Website design, logos, and band name are protected by copyright and may not be used without permission.
terms.disclaimer_availability_desc: We do not guarantee uninterrupted access to our website or services. Maintenance, updates, or technical issues may cause temporary unavailability. We will make every effort to notify you in advance of planned maintenance or service interruptions.
terms.disclaimer_links_desc: Our website may contain links to third-party sites. We are not responsible for their content or privacy practices.
terms.disclaimer_liability_desc: {bandName} shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of our services.
terms.limitation_desc: We reserve the right to limit or restrict access to our website and services for security, legal, or other legitimate reasons. We may do this without prior notice if necessary to protect the integrity of our services or the safety of our users.
terms.law_text_1: These Terms shall be interpreted and governed by the laws of Ukraine, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.
terms.law_text_2: Any disputes arising from these Terms or your use of our services will be resolved in accordance with Ukrainian law and jurisdiction.
terms.changes_text_1: We reserve the right to modify or replace these Terms at any time. If a revision is material, we will try to provide at least {dataResponseTime} notice prior to any new terms taking effect.
terms.changes_text_2: What constitutes a material change will be determined at our sole discretion. By continuing to access or use our services after those revisions become effective, you agree to be bound by the revised terms.
terms.contact_text: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us:
terms.contact_response: We will respond to your inquiries within {dataResponseTime}.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.subtitle: Learn about how we use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience on our website.
cookies.what_text_1: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device when you visit our website. They help provide you with a better browsing experience by remembering your preferences and enabling certain features.
cookies.what_text_2: Currently, the {fullBandName} ({bandName}) website does not use cookies. This policy explains how cookies may be used in the future and how you can control them.
cookies.types_title: Types of Cookies We May Use
cookies.types_intro: If we implement cookies in the future, they will fall into two categories:
cookies.essential_desc: These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly and cannot be disabled. They enable basic functions like page navigation, security, and form submissions.
cookies.essential_examples: Session management, security tokens, language preferences
cookies.nonessential_desc: These cookies are used for various purposes including analytics and enhanced functionality. They help us understand how visitors use our website and remember your preferences.
cookies.manage_text_1: When cookies are implemented on our website, you will be able to manage your preferences directly on our site. You can choose to accept all cookies, only essential cookies, or customize your settings.
cookies.manage_text_2: You can also control cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to view, delete, and block cookies.
cookies.consent_text: If cookies are implemented, when you first visit our website, you will see a cookie consent banner. This will allow you to choose your preferences.
cookies.consent_accept_desc: Allows both essential and non-essential cookies for the best website experience.
cookies.consent_essential_desc: Only allows essential cookies necessary for basic website functionality.
cookies.updates_text_1: We may update this Cookies Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, new technologies, or legal requirements. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
cookies.updates_text_2: We encourage you to review this policy periodically to stay informed about how we use cookies and how you can manage your preferences.
cookies.contact_text: If you have any questions about our use of cookies or this Cookies Policy, please contact us:

about.section_subtitle: Discover the story behind the music
about.content: WBM Band is a modern rock group pushing the boundaries of alternative music. With a unique blend of classic rock influences and contemporary sounds, we create atmospheric experiences that resonate with listeners worldwide. Our journey began with a shared passion for music that transcends genres, and today we continue to evolve, experiment, and connect with our audience through powerful performances and meaningful lyrics. From intimate studio sessions to electrifying live shows, we pour our hearts into every note, creating music that speaks to the soul.
